fact: As at 20 January 2026 the Criminal Records Information Management System (CRIMS), which is to record digitally every step from the crime report through investigation, charge, trial and sentence for joint use by the Ministry of Justice, the Federal Police Commission and the Addis Ababa Police Commission, was still being developed by the Ethiopian Artificial Intelligence Institute, with no station named as using it.
title: የወንጀል ፍትሕ ስርዓቱን ዲጂታላይዝ የሚያደርግ ቴክኖሎጂ በመልማት ላይ መሆኑ ተገለጸ
